One of the first quests in Rookgaard: go down into the village sewers, get past the rats and open the quest chest to receive a {item:Rapier}.
Nothing required; a shield is recommended.
You can run past the rats instead of killing them, but at level 1 a shield helps a lot.
Go to the entrance of the **Rookgaard** sewers and go in. You don't need any item to get in or out.
Inside, go **west** and go down a {item:Ladder|ladder}. On the way you will meet a few {creature:Rat|Rats}.
Map: yellow = sewer entrance, green = ladder
Down there are between 3 and 7 {creature:Rat|Rats}. Kill them or simply run past them.
Sometimes there are {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} lured by other players.
The quest box is in the **northeast** part of the room. Use it to get the {item:Rapier}.
The quest box with the Rapier
To leave, go back the same way: return to the {item:Ladder|ladder} you went down, climb it, head **east** through the sewers to the entrance and come out into the streets of Rookgaard.
